defs.def: to move or to do sth with great speed, often too fast 迅速移动；急促

ex.s: ●___19___ Minimize impact and maximize experience by skipping major holidays or rush hour.
ex.t: ●____ 避开主要节假日或高峰时段，把影响降到最低，把体验提升到最高。

ex.s: I woke up early and rushed out of the door in my eagerness to get to know my new school.
ex.t: 我早早醒来，迫不及待地冲出家门，渴望了解我的新学校。

ex.s: “Impetuous has two definitions: rushing with great force or violence; acting suddenly, with little thought. ”
ex.t: “Impetuous”有两个释义：以巨大的力量或暴力猛冲；突然行动，很少思考。

ex.s: He rushed out of Mrs Hill’s house and crossed the street quickly.
ex.t: 他冲出希尔太太的房子，迅速穿过街道。

ex.s: A． rush quickly to a lift
ex.t: A．迅速冲向电梯

defs.def: to transport or send sb/sth somewhere with great speed 快速运输；速送

ex.s: We invest a lot in roads that help us rush through, but we fail to account for the true costs.
ex.t: 我们在有助于快速通行的道路上投入巨大，却未能算清真正的代价。

defs.def: to do sth or to make sb do sth without thinking about it carefully （使）仓促行事，匆忙行事，做事草率

ex.s: Why the Rush?
ex.t: 为什么这么匆忙？

ex.s: Grant told him about the_____34_____and they rushed into the smoky building.
ex.t: 格兰特把____34____的事告诉了他，他们冲进了烟雾弥漫的大楼。

ex.s: So two by two,I read library books as fast as I could go: rushing them home in the basket of my bicycle.
ex.t: 所以两本两本地，我尽可能快地读图书馆的书：把它们匆忙放在我的自行车篮子里带回家。

ex.s: As I rushed outdoors to empty the wastepaper baskets, the door swung shut behind me.
ex.t: 当我匆忙跑到户外去倒废纸篓时，门在我身后砰地关上了。

ex.s: Without a word, I rushed him to the hospital.
ex.t: 二话不说，我赶紧把他送到了医院。

ex.s: If they’re rushing into something and should wait and be patient, you could say”3 __________”.
ex.t: 如果他们在仓促行事而应该等待和耐心，你可以说"3 __________"。

defs.def: to try to attack or capture sb/sth suddenly 突袭；突击抓捕
to run into sb who has the ball 突袭，冲向（持球人）

ex.s: Grant rushed to a side____24____and ran up the stairs.
ex.t: 格兰特冲向一旁的____24____，然后跑上楼梯。

ex.s: He just wanted to see his younger brother, who had been rushed to the medical area.
ex.t: 他只是想见到被紧急送往医疗区的弟弟。

ex.s: They rushed to the window, 30 or 40 birds all trying to _____33_____ at the same time, and pepperoni—everywhere.
ex.t: 他们冲向窗户，30或40只鸟都试图同时_____33_____，到处都是意大利辣香肠。

ex.s: I speak with the on-duty nurse, who tells me that Lara's parents rushed her to the hospital after she fell off her bicycle.
ex.t: 我和值班护士谈话，她告诉我Lara从自行车上摔下来后，父母紧急把她送到了医院。

defs.def: to move forward and gain ground by carrying the ball and not passing it 带（球）奔跑；跑动带（球）
to give a lot of attention to sb, especially to a student because you want them to join your fraternity or sorority （为物色、招募目的）特别关注，非常关心

ex.s: Next time you see a young person lost in thought, don’t rush to pull them back.
ex.t: 下次你看到年轻人陷入沉思，别急着把他们拉回来。

defs.def: a sudden strong movement 猛烈移动；冲
a situation in which you are in a hurry and need to do things quickly 匆忙；仓促

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市法克托里亚大道上的交通信号灯通常不会连续两次亮相同时长的绿灯，尤其是在高峰时段。

defs.def: a situation in which people are very busy and there is a lot of activity 忙碌；繁忙

ex.s: Today, people still come and go — to see where the Canadian gold rush happened.
ex.t: 如今，人们仍然来来往往——去看加拿大淘金热发生的地方。

defs.def: a sudden strong emotion or sign of strong emotion 迸发的情绪；情绪迸发
a sudden feeling of extreme pleasure or excitement 突如其来的极度愉悦（或兴奋）

ex.s: It was a rush I had never experienced before.
ex.t: 那是我从未体验过的一种兴奋感。

ex.s: Meng Hao’s feelings excited: woke up early; rushed out of the door ____________________________ ____________________________ ____________________________ 1 I saw a white-haired man.

defs.def: a sudden large demand for goods, etc. 大量急需；争购

ex.s: The gold rush in Canada.
ex.t: 加拿大的淘金热。

defs.def: a tall plant like grass that grows near water. Its long thin stems can be dried and used for making baskets, the seats of chairs, etc. 灯芯草（干燥后可用于编制篮子、坐垫等）

ex.s: Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

defs.def: the first prints of a film/movie before they have been edited 样片；毛片

ex.s: They’ll come rushing in,   42  their handbag’s been stolen.
ex.t: 他们会冲进来，   42  说她们的手提包被偷了。

defs.def: an occasion when a player or players run towards a player on the other team who has the ball （向对方持球队员的）突袭
an occasion when a player runs forward with the ball 跑动带球
the time when parties are held for students who want to join a fraternity or sorority 学生联谊会纳新活动（时间）
